title: Could not hang on the wall as advertised
text: Could not hang on the wall as advertised. I could not find any wall hanging hardware in the package as advertised. However, I ended up putting it in the shower. It is just a hair too big for the shelf, but it hasn't been a problem yet. It fits everything I want it to and more. And I see no where on it where it has rusted or where it could potentially rust. Just upset that I wanted to hang it and couldn't.
